meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Brand Governance, Asset Architecture & Production Handoff

objective: Make Production-Locked Phases 01–10 executable and resistant to accidental drift across design, backend/CMS, web, iOS, Android, editorial and marketing.

source_of_truth.brand_bible: Brand Identity Bible 2026 V1 + phase lock records
source_of_truth.code: versioned design tokens and canonical asset package
source_of_truth.product: locked UX baselines remain authoritative for structure
source_of_truth.rule: A derived mockup, screenshot, campaign export or local copied asset never becomes a new source of truth.

asset_architecture.rule: Exports inherit canonical IDs/version; filename convenience never replaces registry identity.

ownership.Brand/Design: identity geometry, visual semantics, lock decisions
ownership.Product/UX: information architecture and locked experience hierarchy
ownership.Engineering: faithful implementation, token/asset consumption, runtime QA
ownership.rule: No function may silently override another function's locked authority.

change_control.patch: implementation correction with no semantic/geometry/hierarchy change; document and test
change_control.minor: backward-compatible addition/variant; requires owner review + QA
change_control.major: changes locked geometry, semantics, hierarchy or governing principle; requires explicit re-open decision and impact review
change_control.emergency: legal/safety/truth/accessibility correction may ship quickly but must be documented and reconciled into canonical baseline

handoff.rule: Implementation tickets reference canonical asset/token IDs rather than screenshots alone.

repository.generated: platform exports may be generated from canonical masters; generated output is not manually edited
repository.checksum: release-critical canonical assets should be checksum/version verified in CI

ci_gates: forbid unknown logo assets in production surfaces
validate token references and deprecated tokens
SVG/icon lint for viewBox/currentColor/accessibility contract where applicable
media UI cannot publish evidence-sensitive assets without required classification/provenance fields
store/marketing production package requires truth/disclosure checklist
snapshot/visual regression on critical brand surfaces
locale overflow/text scaling checks on critical templates

exceptions.format: exceptionId, owner, reason, affected surface, rule waived, risk, expiry/review date, approval
exceptions.rule: Exceptions are explicit, scoped and expiring; repeated exceptions trigger system review rather than becoming undocumented precedent.

deprecation.rule: Never delete/replace a locked asset silently. Mark deprecated, identify successor, migrate consumers, then retire.
deprecation.compatibility: major asset/token changes require migration notes.

ai_agent_handoff.Claude: backend/CMS contracts, media/provenance enforcement and API/domain implementation must consume locked brand/content contracts without inventing UI semantics
ai_agent_handoff.Codex: web/mobile implementation consumes canonical assets/tokens and locked UX baselines; may fix implementation issues but cannot redesign locked phases
ai_agent_handoff.prompt_rule: Every implementation prompt states locked baselines, canonical files/IDs, allowed changes, prohibited redesign and required QA evidence.
